CustomField.description: Calculates the business hours (9am-5pm) between the Created Date and the Closed Date fields
CustomField.formula: ROUND( 8 * ( ( 5 * FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE( ClosedDate ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7) + MIN(5, MOD( DATEVALUE( ClosedDate ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7) + MIN( 1, 24 / 8 * ( MOD( ClosedDate - DATETIMEVALUE( '1900-01-08 12:00:00' ), 1 ) ) ) ) ) - ( 5 * FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ) - DATE( 1996, 1, 1), 7 ) + MIN( 1, 24 / 8 * ( MOD( CreatedDate - DATETIMEVALUE( '1900-01-08 12:00:00' ), 1) ) ) ) ) ), 0 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Business hours between the Created Date and the Closed Date fields
CustomField.label: Hours Open
